back.es: to cross (to go across; also to cross paths, to cross one's arms)
back.example: We cross the street carefully. (could also be read as 'We crossed the street carefully.')

note: The preterite crucé only changes z to c for spelling, which is normally not counted as irregular, so irregular false is right; also, Cruzamos can mean the past too, but the present-tense translation is fine.
